intro: Unleash Chaos on the High Seas
description:
Pirate Havoc is a fast-paced action shooter set in a chaotic, sun-soaked pirate world where danger lurks around every corner. Step into the boots of a ruthless pirate and fight your way through lively ports, narrow streets, and explosive battlegrounds. Use classic flintlock weapons, outmaneuver your enemies, and unleash pure havoc in intense combat encounters.
Explore vibrant environments inspired by Caribbean towns, engage in thrilling gunfights, and dominate your foes with skill and precision. Whether you're ambushing enemies in tight alleys or battling in open plazas, every moment is packed with action, strategy, and destruction.

Do you have what it takes to rule the seas and become the most feared pirate of all?
